name: Can an existing bathtub be converted into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can an existing bathtub be converted into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an old bathtub into a walk-in shower is one of the most common bathroom remodeling requests. The process involves removing the existing tub, inspecting the subfloor and framing for hidden leaks, and reconfiguring the plumbing to adjust water line heights and drain placement. Bathtub drains are typically 1.5 inches, whereas dedicated shower stalls require a 2-inch drain pipe to handle standing water volume properly. Converting to a walk-in shower improves accessibility, creates a spacious feel, and allows for features like built-in seating or barrier-free entries.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, tubs can be converted into walk-in showers. The job involves removing the tub, updating the drain size to 2 inches, and waterproofing the surround.
